title: Tesla at Wardenclyffe tapping the ether

tellings.quote: Tesla was doing at Wardenclyffe, high voltages, short distances, where he's claiming to tap the ether for free energy,

plain: Around 1900 to 1903, at Wardenclyffe, his laboratory in New York, the inventor Nikola Tesla is said to have worked with high voltages over short distances while claiming he could tap the ether, an invisible medium once thought to fill all of space, for free energy. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, on an episode with a guest named Dave Rossi. If true, it would mean a source of limitless power was within reach more than a century ago.
